content: BACTROBAN CREAM (mupirocin calcium cream, 2%) is a topical formulation that contains the dihydrate crystalline calcium hemi-salt of the antibiotic mupirocin. The chemical name of mupirocin is (αE,2S,3R,4R,5S)-5-tetrahydro-3,4-dihydroxy-β-methyl-2H-pyran-2-crotonic acid, ester with 9-hydroxynonanoic acid, calcium salt (2:1), dihydrate. The molecular formula of mupirocin calcium is (C26H43O9)2Ca2H2O, and its molecular weight is 1075.3. In contrast, the molecular weight of mupirocin in its free acid form is 500.6. BACTROBAN CREAM is presented as a white cream that contains 2.15% w/w mupirocin calcium, which is equivalent to 2.0% mupirocin free acid. The cream is formulated as an oil-in-water emulsion. The inactive ingredients in the cream include benzyl alcohol, cetomacrogol 1000, cetyl alcohol, mineral oil, phenoxyethanol, purified water, stearyl alcohol, and xanthan gum.
